accepted.title: decode-uri-component vulnerable to denial of service via quadratic replacement of percent-encoded runs
accepted.accepted: Ships in the app. expo-router parses deep links through query-string, and app.json registers three autoVerify App Link prefixes, so this reads attacker-supplied input. The patched releases (decode-uri-component 0.5.1, query-string above 9.4.1) are ESM-only and cannot be require()d by query-string@7 under expo-router@57 — checked, not assumed — so the fix is expo-router@58, a major that moves the Expo SDK. FSEC-001 remediation item 4.
